schema_note: v2.8 municipal capacity pre-assessment methodology responding to the implementability review gap 'municipal capacity unresolved'. Four subjects (power, compute, water supply and drainage, heating) each carry a formula skeleton, dimension placeholders and a recheck trigger. Every dimension stays value_status=pending_baseline — the file contains no estimates or measured values; conclusions are jointly reviewed and published by the district authority and professional agencies after official special-plan data are released.

dimensions.name_zh: 边缘算力节点单点功率
dimensions.name_en: Per-node power demand of edge-compute nodes
Service-facility load of the six halls

subjects.recheck_trigger_zh: 官方电力专项规划或供电部门容量资料发布。
subjects.recheck_trigger_en: Release of the official power special plan or capacity data from the power-supply authority.

subjects.recheck_trigger_zh: 算力专项资料或实测负荷发布。
subjects.recheck_trigger_en: Release of compute special-plan data or measured loads.

subjects.formula: W_demand = Σ(unit_i_demand × scale_i); drainage checked by equivalent load and return period

discipline.no_estimate_policy_zh: 全部参数为占位（pending_baseline），本文件不含任何估算值、实测值或假设值；公式仅为核算框架。
discipline.no_estimate_policy_en: All parameters are placeholders (pending_baseline); this file contains no estimates, measured values or assumed values — the formulas are accounting frames only.
discipline.publication_policy_zh: 承载力结论仅在官方专项资料发布并完成核算后，由属地主管与专业机构联合复核发布。
discipline.publication_policy_en: Capacity conclusions are published only after official special-plan data are released and the accounting is jointly reviewed by the district authority and professional agencies.

linkage.sequencing_methodology_zh: 挂接排序方法论环节①（S1-DATA 数据基线）：市政承载力属数据基线缺口，官方专项资料发布后进入复算（见 visual/assets/sequencing-methodology.json）。
linkage.sequencing_methodology_en: Hooked to step ① of the sequencing methodology (S1-DATA data baseline): utility capacity is a data-baseline gap entering recomputation once official materials are released (see visual/assets/sequencing-methodology.json).
linkage.climate_carbon_zh: 电力与算力科目核算结果挂接 climate-carbon-framework.json 的碳/能源科目口径（见 visual/assets/climate-carbon-framework.json）。
linkage.climate_carbon_en: Power and compute accounting feeds the carbon/energy subjects of climate-carbon-framework.json (see visual/assets/climate-carbon-framework.json).

boundary_zh: 方法论骨架（待官方资料）：不含任何数值结论，全部维度保持 pending_baseline；承载力判断以官方专项资料发布后的联合复核为准。
boundary_en: Methodology skeleton pending official data: no numeric conclusions, all dimensions remain pending_baseline; capacity judgements rest on joint review after official special-plan release.
